newsitem.title: TURKEY: Explosion in Istanbul cosmetic factory.
newsitem.headline: Explosion in Istanbul cosmetic factory.

text.p: Fire ripped through a cosmetic factory in the Istanbul district of Pendik on Tuesday, touching off an explosion in a liquid gas tank, state-run Anatolian news agency said.
The explosion was followed by a series of smaller blasts, the agency said. There was no immediate word of any casualties.
"Efforts to put out the fire are continuing. There is no immediate information on dead or injured. We cannot get close to the area," a Pendik security official told Reuters by telephone.
Television pictures showed plumes of black smoke rising and fire crews from surrounding districts going to the scene.
